causes.text: Tesla signaled further price cuts after posting pressured margins, reinforcing concerns about an intensifying EV price war. Lower realized pricing by a scale leader narrows room for premium rivals to hold margins.

source_info.title: Tesla growth faces roadblocks as price cuts take toll on margins

effects.text: EV peers traded lower on fear of sustained markdowns and demand elasticity. Lucid shares slumped as investors priced tougher unit economics for luxury EVs amid a broader price war narrative.

source_info.title: Tesla tumbles as investors balk at Musk's price-cutting spree

causal_reasoning_chain.description: Tesla pointed to further price cuts after margins compressed, signaling an extended price war across EVs.
Investors extrapolated lower pricing power and mixed demand responses for premium EV makers, increasing discount rates on cash flows.
On 2023-04-20, Lucid's stock fell intraday by 7.0% (down) as markets repriced EV unit economics under intensified competition.

rationale: A dominant player's pricing action anchors consumer reference prices and compresses rivals' contribution margins. Luxury positioning does not fully shield a startup in scale-up mode.
counterfactual_analysis: Had Tesla indicated price stability or firmer margins, the negative peer read-through would likely have been smaller and Lucid's decline muted.

adversarial_confounders.text: Concurrent macro data releases could move all growth stocks lower.
adversarial_confounders.impact: Such effects are diffuse; the EV-specific narrative better explains the concentrated moves in EV names.

adversarial_confounders.text: Idiosyncratic trading flows may exaggerate intraday volatility.
adversarial_confounders.impact: They can affect sizing, but the direction is aligned with the price war signal.

details.commentary: Tesla's renewed price cuts compressed margins and raised the bar for how aggressively other EV makers must price to stay competitive. That intensifying price war left less room for Lucid to protect profitability at premium price points, so investors sold the stock in anticipation of weaker unit economics.
